integrity: Proof gives all-size result by core decomposition and Burnside. Standard-library enumerator checks all bipartite Prüfer words at m=5,6 and formal coefficients through m=40; computational checks alone are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four hubs and strictly larger opposite shore; balanced case and other hub counts not classified. Four known core-orbit types give a rational series. More general unlabelled-bicoloured-tree enumeration may subsume the special case.
title: Four core types and the exact spanning-tree-type series of \(K_{4,m}\)
